panel_notes: 12 instruments, chosen to avoid near-duplicates by construction. Excluded as duplicate factors: ^GSPC (=SPY), ^RUT (=IWM), XLK (=QQQ), RSP (SPY reweight), IEF/SHY (=TLT curve), EWY/KS11 (retired). Serving measurement stays on ^GSPC/BTC-USD.

fold_geometry.note: BTC-style 7d calendars keep the same bar counts

bootstrap.scheme: two-level paired cluster: outer=instrument, inner=leg, shared draw matrix across candidates

comparators.momo_floor_scoring: median of family = primary comparator; max of family = adversarial guardrail (G11). Third factor for all rules = pit clock terciles (train-fitted).
comparators.clockroll_hedged: pit clock carried at unconditional train survival rate; exact6 never quoted

side_head.design_matrix: 12 DEFAULT_PHASE_FEATURES + close/MA_w - 1 for w in {20,60,200} + causal z(ret_20)
side_head.third_factor: labels_pit.pit_state clock, DECLARED FLAT (train-slice conditional ~ 1/3), zero parameters
side_head.calibration: p_final = (1-lambda)*uniform + lambda*p_head; lambda in [0,1] 41-point grid, fitted by inner-holdout (252 bars) log-loss on weak target. ONE fitted scalar.

G2.note: point estimate in (0,+0.015) is reported as NOT IDENTIFIED, never a win

G12.metric: S0 lag-fix regression on serving arms
G12.threshold: exact6 drop <= 0.010 vs 2026-07-30 anchors; if exceeded, republish all downstream artifacts before promoting anything

G15.threshold: median shuffled effect < 25% of true; 5-95 envelope must not contain true

G17.threshold: historical values bit-identical across two fetches >= 7d apart

G18.threshold: gold_used_for_training=false; zero LeakageAuditor critical; agent_verify passes; Korean disclaimer on every touched surface

kill_conditions.K1: G3 fails -> momentum-floor finding does not replicate on panel; stop, KS11-era measurement was single-market artifact
kill_conditions.K2: G2 fails -> SHIP momo_floor as the head, DELETE side.py. Pre-registered acceptable outcome.
kill_conditions.K3: G4 fails -> ship uniform as served posterior (lambda=0), head kept for ordinal call only, confidence_is_calibrated=false permanently
kill_conditions.K4: G13 fails or any LeakageAuditor critical -> hard stop, revert branch
kill_conditions.K5: G15/G16/G17 fail for a block -> drop that block only
kill_conditions.K6: G12 exceeded -> republish every published number first; that becomes the priority work
kill_conditions.K7: G14 fails -> remove the confidence band from the UI entirely rather than render a miscalibrated one
kill_conditions.K8: panel side median < 0.600 after S0 -> momentum floor was partly riding leaks; stop and report
